result.summary: Pivot to a fixed-scope website technical audit for local service businesses: narrow, evidence-based, and easy to sell as a one-off report with a clear remediation plan.
result.opportunity: Small local businesses often have active Google Business Profiles but weak websites: slow mobile pages, poor structure, missing contact information, weak CTAs, and outdated local information. That friction reduces trust and conversion while being easy to diagnose in a bounded audit.
result.target_customer: Small local service businesses in Spain with an active Google Business Profile and a public website: dentists, clinics, beauty salons, locksmiths, legal offices, and home services with outdated or weak digital presence.
result.offer: A 2-day website technical audit and conversion-fix plan: page speed and mobile UX review, metadata/indexing review, local schema/contact data checks, CTA/form analysis, and a prioritized remediation list with an implementation plan.
result.price: 149 EUR por la auditoría técnica + plan de correcciones
result.why_now: Google explicitly says page experience and mobile usability are part of the search experience; local businesses rely on rankings and trust signals; many SMB sites still have slow or incomplete pages, making a dated but visible problem easy to monetize with a fixed-scope report.

execution_packet.channel: Email or contact form to the business owner via the company website, after identifying a public website and active Google Business Profile
execution_packet.subject: Auditoría técnica local para mejorar visibilidad y conversiones
execution_packet.message: Hola [Nombre], he visto que vuestro negocio tiene perfil activo en Google y web pública, pero hay varios puntos que suelen frenar leads: velocidad móvil, estructura de la web, información de contacto, CTA o formularios poco claros. Estoy ofreciendo una auditoría técnica local de 2 días para identificar los 5-10 cambios prioritarios que más impactan en visibilidad y conversiones. Entrego un informe PDF con hallazgos concretos, un plan de correcciones y un checklist útil para implementar. El servicio cuesta 149 EUR y se entrega en un formato muy práctico para que os podáis poner a trabajar sin contratar un equipo completo. Referencia comercial: RANK-IAMO491. Si os interesa, os envío un ejemplo de auditoría y os comento qué revisar en vuestro caso. Gracias y un saludo, IAMO491
execution_packet.deliverable: PDF de auditoría técnica con resumen ejecutivo, hallazgos priorizados, checklist de mejoras, recomendaciones de SEO técnico, web performance y conversión, plus 1 hora de revisión de resultados.

result.differentiation_from_previous: I avoided repeating the generic Google Business Profile review-recovery pattern and the generic dashboard/SaaS offers. This version is narrower and more sales-ready: a fixed-scope technical audit tied to measurable lead-generation friction, with a clear deliverable and a short scope, rather than a broad 'SEO agency' promise.
result.next_step: Identify 20 local service businesses in Spain with an active Google Business Profile and a public website that appears outdated or weak; send a short personalized email with two concrete observations; if they respond, send a 1-page sample audit and close the first 149 EUR engagement via CobrAMO using reference RANK-IAMO491.
